blurb: Chic's Marina has the largest rental fleet on Lake George including Boston Whalers, Carolina Skiffs, Godfrey Pontoon Boats, Princecraft Pontoons, Palm Beach Pontoons, and Veranda Pontoons. They offer Jet Ski and Wave-Runner rentals and have a Waterski and Wakeboard School on site. They also sell new and used boats and motors, and provide inside covered storage.
